content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

There should be a higher fine for dog dirt on the pavement. Dog dirt is disgusting and a hygiene problem. Also children, adults and other animals aren't allowed to leave droppings on the pavement. If you dispose of the waste then and there yourself, no fine is necessary.
What is the relation between "If you dispose of the waste then and there yourself, no fine is necessary." and "There should be a higher fine for dog dirt on the pavement." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
